ios.desc:
Imagine if dinosaurs never went extinct.
Imagine if magic was real.
Imagine if you could rewrite history.

On ImagineIf, every story starts with "Imagine if..." — and then the world takes over.

"Imagine if..." — that's how you start your chain. Thousands continue with 280-character segments. AI automatically generates a unique visual for every contribution. Stories branch, grow, and go in directions you never expected.

HOW IT WORKS

Start a chain: write your "Imagine if..."
The community adds their 280-character segment
AI instantly creates a unique visual for each contribution
Stories branch based on what the community writes

WHO IS IT FOR?

Writers who want a creative community, not an empty page
Fanfiction and roleplay fans
Anyone curious what AI does with human imagination
Fantasy, horror, romance, sci-fi, anime lovers

WHY IMAGINEiF?

Real-time translation in 22 languages
Every segment gets its own AI-generated visual
Stories never end — they branch into infinite directions
Safe community with content moderation

Imagine if you started a story today.
Start a chain. Free.

quotes.text:
ImagineIf is a platform where users collaboratively write stories, one 280-character segment at a time, and AI generates a visual for each contribution automatically.
Each story starts with an "Imagine if..." prompt. Anyone can continue a chain — the AI produces an image for every new segment using FLUX-dev (Replicate as primary, fal.ai as fallback). Stories can branch based on contributor choices.
Tech stack: React Native/Expo (web PWA + iOS + Android), FastAPI backend, MariaDB, Celery+Redis for async image gen, Groq/Llama for moderation and translation, FLUX-dev for visuals.
What's live today:

Web: https://imagineif.app
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/imagineif-story-chains/id6759722274
Android in closed testing
22 language support with automatic translation pipeline

The hardest part technically was building a reliable dual-provider image pipeline that degrades gracefully without blocking the user's contribution flow — a failed image generation shouldn't interrupt the writing experience.
Happy to answer questions about the architecture or the solo-founder experience.
